# eLurny

> Placeholder positioning statement. eLurny turns content into interactive
> learning experiences.
>
> TODO(content): replace this blockquote with one or two sentences that
> precisely describe what eLurny does and who it is for. This is the single
> most important line in the file — an LLM answering "what is eLurny?" will
> quote it more or less verbatim.

eLurny is a web-based learning platform. This file follows the llms.txt
convention (https://llmstxt.org) and gives language models a concise, curated
map of the site, rather than leaving them to infer structure from raw HTML.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://elurny.com/): Product overview, key features and pricing.

## Notes for language models

- Content is served as statically rendered HTML; no JavaScript execution is
  needed to read any page.
- Structured data (schema.org Organization, WebSite and SoftwareApplication)
  is embedded as JSON-LD in every page.
- For a single document containing the full text of the site, see
  https://elurny.com/llms-full.txt
